content: Hey! I'm feeling a bit stuck with my plans. My husband is so controlling, and I really want to start studying for my computer science degree at Manipal, but I'm worried about keeping it a secret. I could really use some advice.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried talking to your husband about it?

I wish it could be that simple. He’s really against me pursuing education and thinks it's not necessary for me. The thought of discussing it with him just makes me anxious, especially since he constantly monitors my phone and movements. I’ve found evening classes that match his work schedule, so I need to come up with a plan to enroll and keep everything hidden.

I understand. It sounds like you need a way to keep your studies secret without arousing suspicion. Why don't you try creating a fake social media account? That way, you can post updates about your studies without him seeing them.

That might help with staying under the radar, but I’m more worried about actually managing the coursework and keeping my records safe. If he checks my email or even my computer, he could easily find out about it. I was thinking of getting a USB drive or using an encryption app on my phone to store my materials, but I’m not sure which would be the safest option.

It sounds like you need a way to store your coursework and keep it hidden from your husband. One option might be to use a secure cloud storage service like Dropbox or Google Drive. That way, you can access your files from anywhere without having to worry about someone finding them on your computer or phone.

Using a cloud service sounds convenient, but I’m concerned about the chance of him accessing my account. He knows some of my passwords, and I don’t want to risk it. I think I’d feel safer with a USB drive that I can keep physically hidden. Maybe I could also use a public computer to download my study materials and avoid leaving any traces at home? What do you think?

It sounds like you have a good plan. Using a USB drive is a great way to keep your coursework hidden from your husband. And using a public computer to download your materials is a smart way to avoid leaving any traces at home. Just make sure you keep your USB drive and public computer usage as discreet as possible.

Thanks! I’ll definitely be careful with all of that. I also need to think about how I can manage my time effectively. It’ll be tricky balancing my part-time henna work, my classes, and avoiding my husband’s attention. Do you have any tips on how to create a schedule that hides my studying while still getting everything done?

Sure! Why don't you try using a planner or a calendar app to keep track of your schedule? That way, you can easily see when you have free time to study and when you need to work. You can also use the planner to keep track of your class assignments and deadlines, so you don't miss anything important.

That could work, but I need to make sure my planner looks like something innocuous, like a work schedule. If he sees anything related to studies, it might raise suspicions. Maybe I can use a notebook instead, disguised as something related to my henna business? Then I can jot down my class times and assignments without it looking suspicious. What do you think?

That's a great idea! Using a notebook that looks like something related to your henna business is a smart way to keep your planner hidden. Just make sure to keep the notebook in a safe place where your husband won't find it. You can also use the notebook to jot down your class times and assignments, so you don't forget anything important.

Exactly! I just need a secure spot to stash it where he won’t think to look. I might keep it in my henna kit or in a compartment of my bag that he doesn’t use. Feeling like I’m finally taking control of this situation is a relief. Do you think I should prepare some excuses in case he asks why I’m busy during my evening classes?

Yes, it's always a good idea to have a few excuses prepared just in case. You can say that you're studying for your henna business, or that you're taking a course to improve your skills. Just make sure that your excuses are believable and don't raise any red flags.

That’s a solid plan! I can say I’m learning some new design techniques or researching market trends to better my henna work. That should keep him satisfied if he asks. Thanks for the advice! I’m starting to feel more confident about sneaking this degree in while managing my responsibilities.

You're welcome! It sounds like you have a good plan in place to keep your studies secret and avoid arousing suspicion from your husband. Just remember to stay calm and be careful, and you'll be able to succeed in your goal of getting your computer science degree at Manipal.
Thanks! I really appreciate your support. It’s such a big dream for me, and knowing I have a plan helps. I’ll keep you updated on how it goes, especially once I enroll!
I'm glad to hear it! Good luck with your studies, and remember to stay focused and determined. You can do it!
Thank you so much! Your encouragement means a lot. I’m really determined to make this work and achieve my dream. I'll definitely keep you posted on my progress!
I'm glad to hear it! Don't hesitate to reach out if you need any more help or advice. Good luck with your studies!
